mentions.name: artifactguesser.com
mentions.description: A free web game where players see an image of an artifact and guess its country of origin and date. It indexes over 230k artifacts aggregated from 7 museums, includes multiplayer, and acts as a discovery feed for browsing unusual artifacts you wouldn't normally see in museums ('StumbleUpon but for artifacts'). Future plans include 3D museums, 3D artifacts, and hidden tombs to protect and preserve artifacts into the far future.
